strategy.title: Price strategy
strategy.description: A suggestion is built in four steps: reference price (competitors' median listed rate × your target position, or your base price when the sample is too small) → add up adjustments with numbers (tight night, your OTB and pace, day of week, holiday, last minute) → clamp to floor/ceiling and the maximum daily change → round.
strategy.defaults: Using defaults (position 100, max change 15%/day). Save to apply a strategy of your own for this hotel.
strategy.driftNote: The target position also drives the “Your rate drifted from your target position” alert in <link>Notifications</link>.
strategy.noOwnBody: Add your hotel (role “Your hotel”) to the watchlist to set a price strategy.

field.baseHint: Used when fewer than 3 competitors have a price to compare.
field.targetIndexHint: 100 = equal to the comp set's median listed rate; 105 = 5% above; 95 = 5% below.
field.weekdayHint: % added or removed for each night of the week, −30% to +50%. Empty = 0.
field.holidayHint: % for public holidays, Lunar New Year and source-market holidays, −30% to +50%.
field.lastMinuteAdjHint: −30% to 0%, only when the market isn't tight and you still have plenty of rooms.

invalid.floorCeiling: The floor price must be at or below the ceiling price.
invalid.baseRange: The base price must sit between the floor and ceiling prices.
invalid.targetIndex: The target position must be from 50 to 200.
invalid.maxChange: The maximum daily change must be a whole number from 1 to 50.
invalid.weekday: Day-of-week adjustments must be whole numbers from −30 to 50.
invalid.holiday: The holiday uplift must be a whole number from −30 to 50.
invalid.lastMinuteDays: The last-minute window must be a whole number from 0 to 14.
invalid.lastMinuteAdj: The last-minute adjustment must be a whole number from −30 to 0.

outcomes.title: Applied suggestions → results
outcomes.description: Last {days} days. Occupancy and ADR are actual PMS numbers after the stay night.
outcomes.info: On target: raised and still reached ≥85% occupancy, or lowered and reached ≥70%. To review: raised but occupancy <60%, or lowered but <50%. Holds aren't scored. Backtest: re-runs the suggestion rules on competitor prices {lead} days before each past night, then compares with actual occupancy.
outcomes.goodHint: Out of {count} nights with PMS numbers
outcomes.reviewHint: Raised and stayed empty, or lowered and still empty
outcomes.backtestNone: Not enough nights with PMS numbers yet
outcomes.emptyBody: Needs actual PMS numbers after the stay (Settings › PMS import) and suggestions marked “Applied” or “Dismissed”.
